ios.desc:
Compete to put your picture at the top and become the most popular ! 

How does it work?

The purpose is to share quality content with your friends and be rewarded for it.

In Judg’s world, when your popularity rises so does your avatar. You are able to reach plenty of fun levels. The goal? Become the most popular in the world!

You will be able to discover the world’s most famous users and posts thanks to the “Judg celebrities” ranking and the posts “most judged”.

What’s more? Do you also feel that likes or dislikes don’t fully express your opinion? Judg is a safe zone in which you can finally give your opinion with a score from 1 to 10…No more jibber jabber!


Features:

• Edit and share photos and videos with friends, followers or the entire world.
• Put you picture at the top every 3 days.
• Discover the world’s most famous users or posts.
• Raise your popularity and reach plenty of fun levels.
• Climb the ranks and become a Judg celebrity.
• Be inspired by leaders sharing the same passions by searching in brand new categories.
• Complete missions each week and win bonuses
• And much more…
